name: VoiceIsolate Signal Glass
mix: Signal Glass light model on the live local desk. One session, one braid, four ribbons.
doNotInvent: No neural stem model, no 67-control schema, no model SHA, no fake LUFS or ratings
No microphone, record dot, latency claim, or cloud upload
Import stays four filtered focus buses. Demo stays four independent performances
Faders never re-run separation. Mute and solo change the real sum

key.means: Voice and the one primary action

light.glassEdge: 1px at 135deg, cyan 36% to gold 30%, reading surface 88%+
light.primary: Cyan pill, dark ink #061018. One filled primary per screen

session.headline: Bring the voice forward.
session.picture: Helix enters lower left, passes a tilted lens, splits into voice, music, room, and air. Gate names the session or reads Gate closed.
session.honesty: Audio stays on this device. Not a neural split.

stems.meters: Live analyser. Clip is red with the word CLIP. Tap clears the latch.
stems.unity: Instrument-white tick at 0 dB. Shift-drag is fine. Double-click returns to unity.

engineer.curve: Instrument white, never a stem color
engineer.flatMonitor: Bypasses EQ, dynamics, polarity, width, and high-pass without forgetting them

screens.transport: Play is the cyan pill. Loop and Export stay glass. Same mix on every page. Undo and redo stay.

motion.ribbon: Opacity breathe on the voice ribbon only

negative: Gold used as the primary button
Microphone, record, ratings, testimonials, people, device frames
Illegible glass, tilted UI, fake processed-chain chips
